description: MMP holds pairs of Memo values equal up to position p and different at p ('a' versus 'b'), for p = 250, 254, 255, 256, 257, 300, 1000, plus a repeat of row 1. How many value classes does DISTINCT over Memo give overall and per p, what does GROUP BY on the Memo column give (error number if refused), and which lengths do the rows have (control)? Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-13b-main (ACCDB) opened read-only through ACE DAO; each text is opened as a snapshot with Database.OpenRecordset, Fields Name/Type/Size are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-13b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
